description: Search the Datanest catalogue of digital technical products. Accepts natural-language intent queries (e.g. "add authentication to my SaaS", "reduce my AWS bill", "prepare for a system design interview") — stopwords and phrasing are handled, and synonyms are expanded. Returns concise product cards ranked by relevance, with stable canonical URLs. If a query matches little, the result includes suggestions/did_you_mean/available_domains so you can refine. Read-only and public. By default only agent-purchasable products are returned; set include_unsellable=true to also surface unaudited/deprecated items (clearly flagged, not buyable).

domain.description: Filter by domain/family id: data, ai, cloud, dev, security, career.

query.description: Free-text search over title, description, tags, and store.
